mapper.insert: INSERT INTO `order` (order_no, product_id, buyer_id, seller_id, deal_price, status, address_id, remark, delivery_method) VALUES (#{orderNo}, #{productId}, #{buyerId}, #{sellerId}, #{dealPrice}, #{status}, #{addressId}, #{remark}, #{deliveryMethod})
mapper.select: SELECT o.id, o.order_no AS orderNo, o.deal_price AS dealPrice, o.status, o.create_time AS createTime, o.pay_time AS payTime, o.ship_time AS shipTime, o.confirm_time AS confirmTime, o.cancel_time AS cancelTime, o.delivery_method AS deliveryMethod, o.remark, o.buyer_id AS buyerId, o.seller_id AS sellerId, buyer.nickname AS buyerNickname, buyer.avatar AS buyerAvatar, buyer.phone AS buyerPhone, seller.nickname AS sellerNickname, seller.avatar AS sellerAvatar, seller.phone AS sellerPhone, p.id AS productId, p.product_name AS productName, p.description AS productDescription, p.price AS productPrice, p.product_image AS productImage FROM `order` o INNER JOIN user buyer ON o.buyer_id = buyer.id INNER JOIN user seller ON o.seller_id = seller.id INNER JOIN product p ON o.product_id = p.id WHERE o.id = #{id}

SELECT o.id, o.order_no AS orderNo, o.deal_price AS dealPrice, o.status, o.create_time AS createTime, o.delivery_method AS deliveryMethod, o.remark, seller.id AS sellerId, seller.nickname AS sellerNickname, seller.avatar AS sellerAvatar, p.id AS productId, p.product_name AS productName, p.product_image AS productImage FROM `order` o INNER JOIN user seller ON o.seller_id = seller.id INNER JOIN product p ON o.product_id = p.id WHERE o.buyer_id = #{buyerId} ORDER BY o.create_time DESC LIMIT #{offset}, #{pageSize}

SELECT o.id, o.order_no AS orderNo, o.deal_price AS dealPrice, o.status, o.create_time AS createTime, o.delivery_method AS deliveryMethod, o.remark, buyer.id AS buyerId, buyer.nickname AS buyerNickname, buyer.avatar AS buyerAvatar, p.id AS productId, p.product_name AS productName, p.product_image AS productImage FROM `order` o INNER JOIN user buyer ON o.buyer_id = buyer.id INNER JOIN product p ON o.product_id = p.id WHERE o.seller_id = #{sellerId} ORDER BY o.create_time DESC LIMIT #{offset}, #{pageSize}
SELECT DATE_FORMAT(create_time, '%Y-%m') AS month, COUNT(*) AS orderCount, COALESCE(SUM(deal_price), 0) AS totalAmount FROM `order` GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(create_time, '%Y-%m') ORDER BY month DESC

SELECT o.seller_id AS sellerId, u.nickname AS sellerNickname, COUNT(*) AS orderCount, SUM(o.deal_price) AS totalRevenue FROM `order` o INNER JOIN user u ON o.seller_id = u.id WHERE o.status = 3 GROUP BY o.seller_id, u.nickname ORDER BY totalRevenue DESC

SELECT o.id, o.order_no AS orderNo, o.deal_price AS dealPrice, o.status, o.create_time AS createTime, o.delivery_method AS deliveryMethod, o.remark, o.buyer_id AS buyerId, o.seller_id AS sellerId, buyer.nickname AS buyerNickname, seller.nickname AS sellerNickname, p.product_name AS productName, p.product_image AS productImage FROM `order` o INNER JOIN user buyer ON o.buyer_id = buyer.id INNER JOIN user seller ON o.seller_id = seller.id INNER JOIN product p ON o.product_id = p.id ORDER BY o.create_time DESC LIMIT #{offset}, #{pageSize}
